$comment: Single source of truth for the examples list.
One entry per CONCEPT, not per file: merged pages contribute several entries
that share a `file` and differ by `anchor`, so a Guide cross-link still lands
on the exact thing it describes.

scripts/build-examples-archive.mjs  file + data list for the download
